reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'store') * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 3) AS store_line_share
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY parent_category
alternatives: SELECT parent_category, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 3) AS store_line_share FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY parent_category

SELECT parent_category, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*), 3) AS store_line_share FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1
